head: working-tree
subject: MQTT Mosquitto-compatible heap gauges
change: Broker.Options.heap_source lets an application supply an allocation-free HeapSnapshot callback. When configured, Broker.stats() reports heap_current_bytes/heap_maximum_bytes, publishSystemStats emits retained $SYS/broker/heap/current and $SYS/broker/heap/maximum, and the Prometheus renderer emits mqtt_broker_heap_current_bytes/mqtt_broker_heap_maximum_bytes. Without a source the topics and families are omitted entirely, matching Mosquitto builds without WITH_MEMORY_TRACKING, and the existing $SYS payload loop skips absent metrics. The production Mosquitto-style config example wires its memory_limit MemoryLimiter snapshot (current live bytes and peak bytes) into the broker.

tests.unit: src/mqtt/broker_tests.zig verifies stats, retained $SYS values, live updates after a source change, and complete absence without a heap source. src/mqtt/broker/prometheus.zig covers conditional family emission and byte-stable output. src/mqtt/broker.zig covers topic names and null formatting.

notes: The heap callback runs while the broker holds its state mutex, so the contract requires an allocation-free, non-reentrant implementation; the example's MemoryLimiter snapshot only performs atomic loads. Both interop failures in the complete gate are pre-existing environment limits (no Go toolchain), not test regressions.
